latest.title: otosora v0.2.0
latest.notes:
Otosora · 音空 0.2.0

- New icon: the ensō, one brush stroke of the night sky with a sakura petal
- Albums, Artists, and Folders
- Equalizer with presets, loudness boost, and playback speed
- Sleep timer that fades out, or stops at the end of the song
- Synced lyrics in now playing (from LRCLib), saved for offline listening
- Smart playlists: most played, recently played, recently added, never played
- Side menu, custom backgrounds, and in-app updates
- Stream (preview): search YouTube; playback may stop after about a minute while full streaming is finished

Pick the APK for your phone. Most phones today use **arm64-v8a**.
